Confirms the temporary SSH probe account and home were removed.

commands.command:
set -eu
probe_dir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ssh-cert-probe.XXXXXX)
cleanup() {
  userdel -r sshcertprobe >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  rm -rf "$probe_dir"
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -f "$probe_dir/client_key" -N '' -C 'temporary certificate trust probe'
useradd -m -s /bin/sh sshcertprobe
install -d -o sshcertprobe -g sshcertprobe -m 700 /home/sshcertprobe/.ssh
install -o sshcertprobe -g sshcertprobe -m 600 "$probe_dir/client_key.pub" /home/sshcertprobe/.ssh/authorized_keys
restorecon -RF /home/sshcertprobe >/dev/null
printf '@cert-authority %s,%s %s\n' "$NODE_IP" "$NODE_NAME" "$(cat /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ca.pub)" > "$probe_dir/known_hosts"
chmod 600 "$probe_dir/known_hosts"
ssh -vv -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile="$probe_dir/known_hosts" -o GlobalKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -i "$probe_dir/client_key" sshcertprobe@"$NODE_IP" 'printf "CERT_TRUST_CONNECTION_OK node=%s user=%s\\n" "$(hostname)" "$(id -un)"' > "$probe_dir/stdout" 2> "$probe_dir/stderr"
printf '%s\n' '--- trust verification trace ---'
grep -E 'Server host certificate:|Host .* is known and matches the ED25519-CERT host certificate|Found CA key' "$probe_dir/stderr"
printf '%s\n' '--- remote command result ---'
cat "$probe_dir/stdout"
printf '%s\n' '--- known_hosts entry type ---'
awk '{print $1, $2}' "$probe_dir/known_hosts"
